# Fix Monitor atlas-jobs registry under release snapshots

After #6948 merge + kickstart, live `GET /api/atlas-jobs/health` reports:
`registry: .runtime/api/releases/a4c8c4f9…/batch_state/atlas-jobs`
because `registry_dir()` uses `repo_root()` = `Path(__file__).parents[3]`, which inside an immutable API release is the snapshot, not the layout-A primary checkout.

`primary_checkout_root()` already exists in `scripts/lexicon/runner/atlas_job.py` for restic/venv. Point `registry_dir()` (when `ATLAS_JOB_REGISTRY` is unset) at `primary_checkout_root() / "batch_state" / "atlas-jobs"`.

Add a test that a fake `__file__` under `.runtime/api/releases/<sha>/` still resolves the primary registry.

PR against main. Title: `fix(api): read atlas-jobs registry from primary checkout`
Body: `Refs #6944`. Never close #6876. Trailer `X-Agent: cursor/6944-registry`.
pytest tests/test_atlas_job_protocol.py tests/api/test_atlas_jobs_router.py + ruff. Do not merge.

I'll fix atlas-jobs registry resolution so release snapshots use the primary checkout, starting with cold start and locating the current `registry_dir()` / `primary_checkout_root()` code.

There's an existing release-snapshot root pattern in session streams tests; I'll mirror that for atlas-jobs registry resolution.

`registry_dir()` now anchors on the layout-A primary checkout instead of the release snapshot’s `Path(__file__)` root.

**Test:** fake `__file__` under `.runtime/api/releases/<sha>/…` still yields the primary registry path.
